series.name: Green Cards Granted

parts.title: PERSONS OBTAINING LAWFUL PERMANENT RESIDENT STATUS: FISCAL YEARS 1820 TO 2023

series.description: The number of people granted lawful permanent residence (a green card), by fiscal year, rounded by DHS to the nearest ten. Fiscal 1976 runs 15 months, from July 1, 1975 to September 30, 1976, as DHS prints it. The 2010 Yearbook notes: “From 1820 to 1867, figures represent alien passenger arrivals at seaports; from 1868 to 1891 and 1895 to 1897, immigrant alien arrivals; from 1892 to 1894 and 1898 to 2010, immigrant aliens admitted for permanent residence; from 1892 to 1903, aliens entering by cabin class were not counted as immigrants. Land arrivals were not completely enumerated until 1908. For this table, Fiscal Year 1843 covers 9 months ending September, 1843; Fiscal Years 1832 and 1850 cover 15 months ending December 31 of the respective years; and Fiscal Year 1868 covers 6 months ending June 30, 1868.” Every year is dated here as if it ran from July 1. DHS Office of Homeland Security Statistics, Yearbook of Immigration Statistics, fiscal year 2023 (released 2024), Table 1: “PERSONS OBTAINING LAWFUL PERMANENT RESIDENT STATUS: FISCAL YEARS 1820 TO 2023”.
